note: Rio Grande NF (Divide RD), run by a concessionaire; ~21.6 mi from Creede on Hwy 149 (toward Lake City), then 0.3 mi of gravel FR 510. ~9,500 ft, in a meadow on a bench above South Clear Creek with spruce and aspen for some shade; every site faces Bristol Head peak. A short trail leads to an overlook of the Clear Creek canyons and a waterfall. Moose often seen. --Claude

flags: Max length: the FS page says both 'ranging from 35 to 55 feet in length' (description) and 'Maximum spur length is 50 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.' (Parking). Recorded 50; either is well above 23 ft.

Pin 37.81926,-107.14743 vs FS lat/lng 37.81699703,-107.1385841: ~820 m apart. The campground runs 0.6 mile east-west along the bench south of South Clear Creek; on imagery the pin is at the west end by the creek's tree band, ~150 m from the campground road, and the FS point is at the road's east end. The pin is near the west end of the campground rather than off it; a point midway along the bench road (~37.8178,-107.1420) would be more central. No per-site coordinates exist (not on recreation.gov).
Phone 719-657-3321 confirmed (Divide Ranger District, the FS page's contact).

Not waterfront (stored): the page puts the sites on a bench above South Clear Creek with 'the grassy field between camping sites and creek'; imagery agrees (creek in a tree-lined canyon below the bench). No change.
